sources.title: Piracy monthly report for April 2026（ANNEX：Acts of piracy and armed robbery allegedly committed / attempted against ships）
sources.text: While underway, the Master observed a sampan alongside the barge, with approximately two perpetrators on board. The perpetrators subsequently escaped from the barge via the sampan. The perpetrators were not armed. The crew were not injured. Some scraped metals were stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore MPA (flag State).
